card.name: Just before a US president's name
card.fires_on: Small words like in, by, under, President or George right before a US president or administration is named. It appears in news text about government posts, policies and appointments.

modes.label: Linking word before administration
modes.description: A preposition or article after a government job, where a president's administration comes next.

modes.label: Title or first name before president
modes.description: The word President or George just before a surname like Bush or Obama.
modes.example: was nominated by<< President>> Barack Obama on May 24,

card.writes: It pushes the model to name a US president or administration next, such as Trump, Obama, Bush or Biden.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a US president or his administration.
